whatChanged: NEW: Palo Alto Networks agrees to buy AI startup Applied Compute for $4.5bn in stock, closing expected fiscal Q3 2027 (panw-applied-compute-acquisition)
NEW: Quebecor makes a ~C$31bn cash-and-stock proposal for Telus; Telus cites serious regulatory concerns as BCE is reported to have held talks too (t-quebecor-takeover-proposal)
NEW: UniCredit and the German government reach broad agreement on Commerzbank takeover terms after unconditional EU clearance (cbk-unicredit-takeover)
NEW: Canadian Natural agrees to buy Montney producer Advantage Energy for C$13.55 a share, ~C$2.53bn including debt (cnq-advantage-energy-acquisition)
NEW: Challenger rejects a revised takeover bid from top shareholder Dai-ichi Life, its second rejection in a month (cgf-daiichi-life-takeover-proposal)
NEW: Accor drops Ennismore IPO plans and will buy out the 44.3% minority for ~€1.6bn through January 2028 (ac-ennismore-minority-buyout)
NEW: LCI and Patrick shareholders approve their all-stock merger, leaving only regulatory approvals (lcii-patrick-merger)

themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: Sponsors, strategics and insiders keep trying to take listed businesses off public markets, and shareholders keep deciding the outcome. Challenger has rejected a second, revised bid from its ~20% holder Dai-ichi Life for the rest of the company (cgf-daiichi-life-takeover-proposal). ICEYE has launched a €41-a-share cash tender offer to take Avio private and delist it (avio-iceye-takeover-offer). easyJet holders approved Apollo's £5.7bn take-private (ezj-apollo-take-private), and CVC and GBL have crossed 90% of Recordati, clearing the way to delisting (rec-cvc-gbl-take-private). H&R REIT unitholders went the other way and voted down the C$6.7bn breakup led by GO Residential and Blackstone (hr-un-go-residential-breakup). HealthSpan raised its Surgery Partners price to $25 after a rival $28 approach (sgry-bon-secours-take-private). Silver Lake and PIF are in preliminary talks to take Unity private at about $25bn (u-silver-lake-pif-take-private), and LS Power has proposed a $2.00-a-share buyout of EVgo's public float (evgo-ls-power-take-private). Wendy's rejected Trian's $7.35 bid and adopted a poison pill (wen-trian-take-private), Helen of Troy rejected Empower Brands' $37 proposal (hele-empower-takeover-proposal), and LCI holders sidelined Monomoy's $104.50 cash approach by approving the Patrick merger (lcii-monomoy-takeover-proposal, lcii-patrick-merger). AVID has matched Warburg Pincus again at A$5.55 for Ingenia (ina-avid-takeover-proposal). Signed deals keep moving: Tata controls ~89% of Iveco (ivg-tata-motors-takeover-offer), and Affle is delisting Perion (peri-affle-acquisition).

themes.label: Signed M&A deals hitting regulatory or legal roadblocks
themes.note: Regulators, courts, governments and supervisors, not the parties, keep setting deal timelines. Telus says the 'largest hurdle' to Quebecor's C$31bn proposal is regulatory, since it would cut Canada's national carriers from four to three (t-quebecor-takeover-proposal). UniCredit needed unconditional EU clearance and a settlement with Berlin over governance before its Commerzbank takeover could proceed (cbk-unicredit-takeover). The US Justice Department will review DoorDash's $17bn Instacart deal, with closing not expected before late 2027 (cart-doordash-uber-acquisition). Consob has cleared Intesa's Monte dei Paschi offer document after ECB authorisation, leaving Italy's antitrust authority as the remaining gatekeeper (isp-bmps-takeover-offer). Marvell's $115bn Lumentum deal is not expected to close until 2028 (mrvl-lumentum-acquisition), Mitsui Chemicals' $11.6bn JSR purchase needs Japanese and foreign approvals (4183-jsr-acquisition), and ICEYE's Avio offer needs Italian, French and UK clearances (avio-iceye-takeover-offer). easyJet's Apollo take-private and the shareholder-approved LCI–Patrick merger now wait only on regulators (ezj-apollo-take-private, lcii-patrick-merger). Western Union terminated its Intermex purchase after California's financial regulator imposed conditions it would not accept (wu-intermex-acquisition). The FTC and states have sued to block Cencora's $3.5bn sale of MWI Animal Health to Covetrus (cor-covetrus-mwi-divestiture), and GO Residential has taken H&R REIT to court over a termination fee (hr-un-go-residential-breakup).

themes.label: Large-caps scaling up buybacks and special payouts on surplus cash
themes.note: Companies with surplus capital keep expanding buybacks and payouts. Costco declared a $30-a-share (~$13.3bn) special dividend alongside a new $4bn repurchase programme (cost-special-dividend-2026), and Lam Research authorized a new open-ended $25bn programme, far above the ~$3.9bn it repurchased in fiscal 2026 (lrcx-buyback-2026).

themes.label: European incumbents consolidating domestic rivals for scale
themes.note: Europe's large chemicals groups, banks, grocers and space companies are buying rivals to reach the scale of US and Chinese peers, while controlling shareholders, governments and supervisors decide the outcomes. UniCredit has reached broad agreement with Berlin on taking over Commerzbank (cbk-unicredit-takeover). Banco BPM's board has opened talks on Crédit Agricole's proposal to merge its Italian arm into the bank (bami-credit-agricole-merger), and Intesa Sanpaolo's Monte dei Paschi offer opens on 24 November (isp-bmps-takeover-offer). Evonik's board has refused to negotiate over BASF's €24-a-share approach, so RAG-Stiftung's ~43% stake is the decisive lever (evk-basf-acquisition). Finland's ICEYE is bidding for Italian launcher maker Avio to build a European space and defence group (avio-iceye-takeover-offer). Ahold Delhaize is buying Tesco's Czech and Slovak arm to make its Albert chain Czechia's market leader (ad-tesco-cz-sk-acquisition).

themes.label: North American energy companies buying scale in core assets
themes.note: Oil, gas, refining and fuels companies are paying up to deepen positions in assets they already know. Canadian Natural is paying ~C$2.53bn including debt for Montney producer Advantage Energy (cnq-advantage-energy-acquisition). Chevron is reported by the FT to be closing in on a majority stake in Blackstone-backed Gulf producer Beacon Offshore, valued near $5bn (cvx-beacon-offshore-acquisition). Diamondback has signed to buy out the rest of its Double Eagle partnership, adding ~176,000 net Midland acres (fang-double-eagle-acquisition), Strathcona is folding in fellow Waterous-controlled oil sands producer Greenfire (scr-greenfire-acquisition), CVR Energy is buying Marathon Petroleum's two Upper Midwest refineries for ~$4.2bn (cvi-mpc-refineries-acquisition), and The Andersons is paying $915m for Harvestone's three ethanol plants (ande-harvestone-acquisition).
